# AI Index Optimizer

> AI Index Optimizer audits whether AI assistants can reach, read and cite a website, then ships the crawler rules, llms.txt, schema and metadata fixes that make a page quotable in AI answers.

## What this site is
A free AI visibility audit for any domain with per-provider results for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, plus copy-paste fix files. Paid plans start at $39 per month for three domains.

## Key pages
- https://ai-index-optimizer.com/ : product overview and how the scan works
- https://ai-index-optimizer.com/geo-audit : free AI visibility audit
- https://ai-index-optimizer.com/pricing : Starter $39/mo 3 domains, Growth $99/mo 10, Agency $299/mo 30

## Images
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai-index-optimizer/ai-index-optimizer/main/assets/brand/logo-lens-512.png : Brand mark, 512 by 512. A magnifying-glass lens whose handle is an upward index arrow, off-white on ink navy with a lime accent.
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai-index-optimizer/ai-index-optimizer/main/assets/brand/logo-bars-512.png : Alternate mark, 512 by 512. Three ascending bars where the tallest becomes a lens aperture.
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai-index-optimizer/ai-index-optimizer/main/assets/brand/favicon-48.png : Favicon, 48 by 48.
All marks are flat vector, no text, readable at 32 pixels.
